purpose: 2026 test: reverse long of smv10_dev1_01_v10_stop210_rr550 plus original short of same strategy
data_scope: 2026 only; dataframe filtered before indicator calculation

legs.original_short: smv10_dev1 original short entry and short bracket exit
legs.reverse_long: smv10_dev1 short entry inverted to long entry and long bracket exit

engine_rules: t open executes pending entries generated by previous close
t candle exits update equity after t open entries
t close creates pending entries for t+1 open
one active position per symbol across both sides
if long and short signal compete for the same symbol and timestamp, higher score has priority
DD brake edge applies from next timestamp
remaining active positions are force-closed at the last 2026 close
